# Soul Buns & Balls

> Independent smash burger bar in Kalamata, Greece. Short menu, fresh daily, open Tuesday to Sunday from 18:00 until sold out. No reservations: first come, first served.

- Address: Anagnostara 3, Kalamata 24100, Greece
- Phone: +30 2721 303682
- Email: soulbunsandballs@gmail.com
- Hours: Tuesday–Sunday from 18:00 until sold out; closed Monday.
- Service: dine in at the bar, takeaway, delivery via Wolt (https://wolt.com/el/grc/kalamata/restaurant/soul-buns-balls)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/soulbunsandballs/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/soulbunsandballs/

## Menu (prices in EUR)
Burgers: Single smash 6.5 (smashed beef patty, cheddar, homemade pickles, iceberg, onions, soul secret sauce); Double smash 9; Triple smash 11.5; Oldschool 9 (classic beef patty, cheddar, homemade pickles, iceberg, onions, soul secret sauce); Burger of the Month (a new creation every month, with fresh seasonal ingredients. November 2026: Kuchisabishii Smash (Potato bun, Smashed patties, Cheddar, Pickled mushrooms, Cabbage, Crunchy fried onion, Kewpie mayo, Tonkatsu ponzu ketchup)).
Fries & sauces: Side fries 2 (skin-on really crunchy fried potatoes); Whole fries 4; Loaded Fries 9 (crunchy fries, sauce of your choice, smashed patty, cheddar, crunchy fried onions, pickles).
Soul Sauces: Soul 1.5; Garlic mayo 1.5; Sriracha mayo 1.5; Truffle mayo 2; Ketchup 1; Mayo 1.
Drinks: Cola 2; Zero 2; Sprite 2; Schweppes 2.5; Sparkling 1.5; Water 0.5; Carlsberg 4; Kalamata 5; Sura 5; IPA beer 6; Paloma 7.

## Burger of the Month — November 2026
Kuchisabishii Smash: Potato bun, Smashed patties, Cheddar, Pickled mushrooms, Cabbage, Crunchy fried onion, Kewpie mayo, Tonkatsu ponzu ketchup.
One new burger every month, served for that month only.

## Past Burgers of the Month
- October 2026: The Local Soul — Potato bun, Smashed patties, Goat graviera, Siglino Manis, Arugula, Crunchy fried onion, Garlic confit mayo
- September 2026: The Deli Smash — Potato bun, Smashed patties, Beef pastrami, Caramelised onions, Cheddar, Homemade pickles, Soul secret sauce
- June 2026: The Mediterranean Job — Potato bun, Smashed patties, Mozzarella, Parmesan, Arugula, Marinara sauce, Garlic mayo
- May 2026: The Metsovo Melt — Potato bun, Double smash or oldschool patty, Caramelised onions, Metsovone, Homemade pickles, Soul secret sauce
- April 2026: Better Than Good — Potato bun, Smashed patties, Cheddar, Homemade pickled onions, Pickle sauce, Ketchup
- March 2026: Two Smoking Barrels — Potato bun, Smashed patties, Cheddar, Bacon, Apple BBQ ketchup, Homemade pickles, Fried crunchy onion
- February 2026: The Oklahoma Original — Potato bun, Smashed patties, Cheddar, Grilled sweet onion, Homemade pickles, Mustard

## Στα ελληνικά
Το Soul Buns & Balls είναι ανεξάρτητο smash burger bar στην Καλαμάτα (Αναγνωσταρά 3, 24100). Ανοιχτά Τρίτη–Κυριακή από τις 18:00 έως sold out· Δευτέρα κλειστά. Χωρίς κρατήσεις. Φαγητό στο μπαρ, πακέτο ή delivery μέσω Wolt. Τηλέφωνο +30 2721 303682.
Burger του μήνα (Νοέμβριος 2026): Kuchisabishii Smash.

Μενού (τιμές σε EUR)
Burgers: Single smash 6.5 (smashed μοσχαρίσιο μπιφτέκι, cheddar, σπιτικά πίκλες, iceberg, κρεμμύδι, soul secret sauce); Double smash 9; Triple smash 11.5; Oldschool 9 (κλασικό μοσχαρίσιο μπιφτέκι, cheddar, σπιτικά πίκλες, iceberg, κρεμμύδι, soul secret sauce); Burger of the Month (μια νέα δημιουργία κάθε μήνα, με φρέσκα εποχιακά υλικά. Νοέμβριος 2026: Kuchisabishii Smash (Potato bun, Smashed patties, Cheddar, Pickled mushrooms, Cabbage, Crunchy fried onion, Kewpie mayo, Tonkatsu ponzu ketchup)).
Πατάτες & σάλτσες: Side fries 2 (πολύ τραγανές τηγανητές πατάτες με τη φλούδα); Whole fries 4; Loaded Fries 9 (τραγανές πατάτες, σάλτσα της επιλογής σου, smashed μπιφτέκι, cheddar, crunchy fried onions, πίκλες).
Soul Sauces: Soul 1.5; Garlic mayo 1.5; Sriracha mayo 1.5; Truffle mayo 2; Ketchup 1; Mayo 1.
Ποτά: Cola 2; Zero 2; Sprite 2; Schweppes 2.5; Ανθρακούχο 1.5; Νερό 0.5; Carlsberg 4; Kalamata 5; Sura 5; Μπίρα IPA 6; Paloma 7.
